text:
ellie: hey team — my PR (#14567) is blocked, CI failing on the 'authz-e2e' shard with intermittent 429s. I think it's hitting a rate limit in the test infra. buildkite: https://bk.example/12345

ci-bot: build #12345 — status: failed — failing tests: authz-e2e::rate-limit.spec (x3 flaky)

mike: can you paste the failing log snippet?

ellie: sure — here's the repeated error:```
2024-06-12T15:02:11Z ERROR request failed status=429 body={"error":"rate_limited"}
2024-06-12T15:02:11Z WARN retry attempt 1
```

devon: @ellie thanks — did this start after you rebased onto main? sometimes our test harness ramps up parallel calls after merges.

ellie: I rebased ~2h ago. repro locally if I run the e2e in parallel it flakes, serial passes.

sam: could be infra quota. @oncall can you check if the staging auth service had any throttling today?

oncall: looking — I see a short spike of 429s for the test-client token between 14:58 and 15:10 UTC, likely throttling from the mock auth gateway. Filing an incident: INC-2024-072.

mike: if it's infra throttling we shouldnt block the PR. Suggest two options: 1) do a targeted rerun for this PR when the spike clears; 2) add a CI tag to run authz-e2e serially for now.

ellie: option 2 seems simplest. How do I tag that in the pipeline?

sam: add `[ci:serial-authz]` to commit message or add env TEST_PARALLEL=1 in the buildkite step.

ellie: pushed update with TEST_PARALLEL=1 — requesting rerun.

ci-bot: build #12346 triggered by ellie — status: running

mike: also let's avoid snapshot updates — this is infra-level, not expected to change snapshots.

el lie: agreed — no snapshot changes.

ci-bot: build #12346 — status: failed — same 429s (still within spike window)

devon: ugh. since the spike is persistent, maybe we should short-circuit these tests when the gateway reports throttling. e.g. detect 429 and mark test as flaky-skipped with a message.

mike: I'm wary of adding logic to product tests to accommodate infra flakiness. Another idea: set a lightweight retry wrapper in the test harness with exponential backoff and a max of 3 attempts. That reduces false negatives without hiding real failures.

ellie: I can add a retry in the harness for auth calls used in tests — small change. will open a follow-up PR to tweak harness and then re-run. That way this PR isn't blocked.

oncall: FYI we've increased gateway quota for test-client until end of week to reduce noise.

sam: +1 on follow-up PR for harness retries; also file a postmortem if INC-2024-072 shows config drift.

ellie: thanks all — for now I'm unblocking PR by removing the e2e from the strict gate (adding ci:allow-e2e-fail temporarily), will land the main fix in a follow-up. ping me if you want a hand with the harness PR. :thumbsup:

mike: please add a short note in the PR description about the transient infra issue and link INC-2024-072 so reviewers aren't confused.

ellie: done — PR description updated. ready for final review when CI calms.

ci-bot: build #12347 (rerun) — queued

mike: thanks. if this keeps happening tomorrow let's consider quarantining the test suite or running authz-e2e against a dedicated mock instance.

ellie: noted. closing the loop here — I'll follow up with the harness PR and update the incident if we see more spikes.

oncall: closing incident if no further spikes in 4 hours.
